title: Dag Flow Procedural Lod Window Options
description: Add puzzle 2d style LOD window select options to dag, flow, and procedural play shells with wasm manual/automatic LOD support.
summary: DAG flow labels now use dedicated theme labelFill/labelHalo tokens serialized from UI foreground and canvas instead of nodeStroke/rasterClear. VelloThemePalette gained label_fill and label_halo fields; paint_scene and ghost preview read them for all append_label text.
